concept.description: Identifies all types that are part of a Hexagon.
concept.cypher: MATCH (hexagon:JMolecules:Architecture:ArchitecturalUnit:Hexagonal:Hexagon)-[:CONTAINS]->(type:Java:Type) RETURN hexagon.id AS Hexagon, type AS HexagonalType ORDER BY Hexagon, HexagonalType.fqn

concept.description: Identifies hexagonal architectural units based on packages annotated by '@org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.Hexagon'.
concept.cypher: MATCH (hexagonPackage:Java:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(packageInfo:Java:Type), (packageInfo)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(annotation:Java:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(:Java:Type {fqn: 'org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.Hexagon'}), (hexagonPackage)-[:CONTAINS*]->(hexagonalType:Java:Type) OPTIONAL MATCH (annotation)-[:HAS]->(id:Value {name: "id"}) OPTIONAL MATCH (annotation)-[:HAS]->(name:Value {name: "name"}) OPTIONAL MATCH (annotation)-[:HAS]->(description:Value {name: "description"}) WITH hexagonPackage, hexagonalType, coalesce(id.value, hexagonPackage.fqn) AS id, name, description WITH hexagonPackage, hexagonalType, id, coalesce(name.value, hexagonPackage.name) AS name, description WITH hexagonalType, id, name, coalesce(description.value, "") AS description MERGE (hexagon:JMolecules:Architecture:ArchitecturalUnit:Hexagonal:Hexagon {id: id, name: name, description: description}) MERGE (hexagon)-[:CONTAINS]->(hexagonalType) WITH hexagon, hexagonalType, [(hexagonalType)-[:DECLARES*]->(inner:Type:Java) | inner] AS inners FOREACH (inner IN inners | MERGE (hexagon)-[:CONTAINS]->(inner) ) RETURN hexagon.id AS Hexagon, hexagonalType AS HexagonalType ORDER BY Hexagon, HexagonalType.fqn

concept.description: Identifies all types that are part of the application core of a hexagon.
concept.cypher: MATCH (hexagon:JMolecules:Architecture:ArchitecturalUnit:Hexagonal:Hexagon)-[:HAS_CORE]->(core:JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal:ApplicationCore), (core)-[:CONTAINS]->(coreType:Type) RETURN hexagon.id AS Hexagon, coreType AS CoreType ORDER BY Hexagon, CoreType.fqn

concept.description: Associates all Java types which are annotated by org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.Application to the application core node of the corresponding hexagon.
concept.cypher: MATCH (hexagon:JMolecules:Architecture:ArchitecturalUnit:Hexagonal:Hexagon)-[:CONTAINS]->(coreType:Java:Type), (coreType:Type)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->()-[:OF_TYPE]->(annotation:Type{fqn: "org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.Application"}) MERGE (hexagon)-[:HAS_CORE]->(core:JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal:ApplicationCore) MERGE (core)-[:CONTAINS]->(coreType) WITH hexagon, core, coreType, [(coreType)-[:DECLARES*]->(inner:Type:Java) | inner] AS inners FOREACH (inner IN inners | MERGE (core)-[:CONTAINS]->(inner) ) RETURN hexagon.id AS Hexagon, coreType AS CoreType ORDER BY Hexagon, CoreType.fqn

concept.description: Associates all Java types in packages which are annotated by org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.Application to the :JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal:ApplicationCore-node of the corresponding hexagon.
concept.cypher: MATCH (hexagon:JMolecules:Architecture:ArchitecturalUnit:Hexagonal:Hexagon)-[:CONTAINS]->(packageInfo:Java:Type), (package:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(packageInfo)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a)-[:OF_TYPE]->(annotation:Type) WHERE annotation.fqn = "org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.Application" AND packageInfo.sourceFileName = "package-info.java" MATCH (package)-[:CONTAINS*]->(coreType:Type) MERGE (hexagon)-[:HAS_CORE]->(core:JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal:ApplicationCore) MERGE (core)-[:CONTAINS]->(coreType) WITH hexagon, core, coreType, [(coreType)-[:DECLARES*]->(inner:Type:Java) | inner] AS inners FOREACH (inner IN inners | MERGE (core)-[:CONTAINS]->(inner) ) RETURN hexagon.id AS Hexagon, coreType AS CoreType ORDER BY Hexagon, CoreType.fqn

concept.description: Identifies all port types of a hexagon.
concept.cypher: MATCH (hexagon:JMolecules:Architecture:ArchitecturalUnit:Hexagonal:Hexagon)-[:HAS_PORT]->(port:JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal:Port), (port)-[:IMPLEMENTED_BY]->(type:Type) RETURN hexagon.id AS Hexagon, port.type AS PortType, port.name AS PortName, type AS Port ORDER BY Hexagon, PortType, PortName, Port.fqn

concept.description: Associates all Java types which are annotated by org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.-Type-Port to the :JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal:Port{name, type}-node of the corresponding hexagon.
concept.cypher: MATCH (hexagon:JMolecules:Architecture:ArchitecturalUnit:Hexagonal:Hexagon)-[:CONTAINS]->(type:Java:Type), (type)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(annotation:Type) WHERE NOT type.sourceFileName = "package-info.java" AND // Need to exclude package-info to avoid defaulting the port name to package-info. Annotated package-info will be evaluated in PortPackage concept. annotation.fqn IN [ "org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.Port", "org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.PrimaryPort", "org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.SecondaryPort" ] OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:HAS]->(name:Value{name: "name"}) WITH hexagon, type, a, coalesce(name.value, type.name) AS name, replace(annotation.name, "Port", "") AS portType WITH hexagon, type, a, name, CASE WHEN portType = "" THEN "Unqualified" ELSE portType END AS portType MERGE (hexagon)-[:HAS_PORT]->(port:JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal:Port{name: name, type: portType}) MERGE (port)-[:IMPLEMENTED_BY]->(type) WITH hexagon, a, port, type OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:HAS]->(description:Value{name: "description"}) SET port.description = coalesce(port.description, description.value) WITH hexagon, port, type, [(type)-[:DECLARES*]->(inner:Type:Java) | inner] AS inners FOREACH (inner IN inners | MERGE (port)-[:IMPLEMENTED_BY]->(inner) ) RETURN hexagon.id AS Hexagon, port.type AS PortType, port.name AS PortName, type AS Port ORDER BY Hexagon, PortType, PortName, Port.fqn

concept.description: Associates all Java types which are in packages that are annotated by org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.-Type-Port to the :JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal:Port{name, type}-node.
concept.cypher: MATCH (hexagon:JMolecules:Architecture:ArchitecturalUnit:Hexagonal:Hexagon)-[:CONTAINS]->(packageInfo:Java:Type), (p:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(packageInfo)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a)-[:OF_TYPE]->(annotation:Type) WHERE packageInfo.sourceFileName = "package-info.java" AND annotation.fqn IN [ "org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.Port", "org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.PrimaryPort", "org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.SecondaryPort" ] MATCH (p)-[:CONTAINS*]->(type:Type) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:HAS]->(name:Value{name: "name"}) WITH hexagon, type, a, coalesce(name.value, p.name) AS name, replace(annotation.name, "Port", "") AS portType WITH hexagon, type, a, name, CASE WHEN portType = "" THEN "Unqualified" ELSE portType END AS portType MERGE (hexagon)-[:HAS_PORT]->(port:JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal:Port{name: name, type: portType}) MERGE (port)-[:IMPLEMENTED_BY]->(type) WITH hexagon, a, port, type OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:HAS]->(description:Value{name: "description"}) SET port.description = coalesce(port.description, description.value) RETURN hexagon.id AS Hexagon, port.type AS PortType, port.name AS PortName, type AS Port ORDER BY Hexagon, PortType, PortName, Port.fqn

concept.description: Identifies all adapter types of a hexagon.
concept.cypher: MATCH (hexagon:JMolecules:Architecture:ArchitecturalUnit:Hexagonal:Hexagon)-[:CONTAINS]->(type:Java:Type), (adapter:JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal:Adapter)-[:IMPLEMENTED_BY]->(type) RETURN hexagon.id AS Hexagon, adapter.type AS AdapterType, adapter.name AS AdapterName, type AS Adapter ORDER BY Hexagon, AdapterType, AdapterName, Adapter.fqn

concept.description: Associates all Java types which are annotated by org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.-Type-Adapter to the :JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal:Adapter{name, type}-node of the corresponding hexagon.
concept.cypher: MATCH (hexagon:JMolecules:Architecture:ArchitecturalUnit:Hexagonal:Hexagon)-[:CONTAINS]->(type:Java:Type), (type)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(annotation:Type) WHERE NOT type.sourceFileName = "package-info.java" AND // Need to exclude package-info to avoid defaulting the adapter name to package-info. Annotated package-info will be evaluated in AdapterPackage concept. annotation.fqn IN [ "org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.Adapter", "org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.PrimaryAdapter", "org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.SecondaryAdapter" ] OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:HAS]->(name:Value{name: "name"}) WITH hexagon, type, a, coalesce(name.value, type.name) AS name, replace(annotation.name, "Adapter", "") AS adapterType WITH hexagon, type, a, name, CASE WHEN adapterType = "" THEN "Unqualified" ELSE adapterType END AS adapterType MERGE (hexagon)-[:HAS_ADAPTER]->(adapter:JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal:Adapter{name: name, type: adapterType}) MERGE (adapter)-[:IMPLEMENTED_BY]->(type) WITH hexagon, a, adapter, type OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:HAS]->(description:Value{name: "description"}) SET adapter.description = coalesce(adapter.description, description.value) WITH hexagon, type, adapter, [(type)-[:DECLARES*]->(inner:Type:Java) | inner] AS inners FOREACH (inner IN inners | MERGE (adapter)-[:IMPLEMENTED_BY]->(inner) ) RETURN hexagon.id AS Hexagon, adapter.type AS AdapterType, adapter.name As AdapterName, type AS Adapter ORDER BY Hexagon, AdapterType, AdapterName, Adapter.fqn

concept.description: Associates all Java types which are in packages that are annotated by org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.-Type-Adapter to the :JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal:Adapter{name, type}-node of the corresponding hexagon.
concept.cypher: MATCH (hexagon:JMolecules:Architecture:ArchitecturalUnit:Hexagonal:Hexagon)-[:CONTAINS]->(packageInfo:Java:Type), (p:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(packageInfo)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a)-[:OF_TYPE]->(annotation:Type) WHERE packageInfo.sourceFileName = "package-info.java" AND annotation.fqn IN [ "org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.Adapter", "org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.PrimaryAdapter", "org.jmolecules.architecture.hexagonal.SecondaryAdapter" ] MATCH (p)-[:CONTAINS*]->(type:Type) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:HAS]->(name:Value{name: "name"}) WITH hexagon, type, a, coalesce(name.value, p.name) AS name, replace(annotation.name, "Adapter", "") AS adapterType WITH hexagon, type, a, name, CASE WHEN adapterType = "" THEN "Unqualified" ELSE adapterType END AS adapterType MERGE (hexagon)-[:HAS_ADAPTER]->(adapter:JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal:Adapter{name: name, type: adapterType}) MERGE (adapter)-[:IMPLEMENTED_BY]->(type) WITH hexagon, a, adapter, type OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:HAS]->(description:Value{name: "description"}) SET adapter.description = coalesce(adapter.description, description.value) RETURN hexagon.id AS Hexagon, adapter.type AS AdapterType, adapter.name AS AdapterName, type AS Adapter ORDER BY Hexagon, AdapterType, AdapterName, Adapter.fqn

concept.description: Maps ports to the application core via a :HAS_PORT relation.
concept.cypher: MATCH (port:JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal:Port)-[:IMPLEMENTED_BY]->(type:Type), (core:JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal:ApplicationCore)-[:CONTAINS]->(type) MERGE (core)-[:HAS_PORT]->(port) RETURN port AS Port

concept.description: Aggregates dependencies between types to the level of Hexagonal components.
concept.cypher: MATCH (c1:JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal)-[:CONTAINS|IMPLEMENTED_BY]->(t1:Type), (c2:JMolecules:Architecture:Hexagonal)-[:CONTAINS|IMPLEMENTED_BY]->(t2:Type), (t1)-[d:DEPENDS_ON]->(t2) WHERE c1 <> c2 WITH c1, c2, sum(d.weight) AS weight MERGE (c1)-[:DEPENDS_ON{weight: weight}]->(c2) RETURN c1 AS Dependent, c2 AS Dependency
